items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire tears, which with Tech X become a lingering (~1s) laser ring at a fixed offset ≈0.15–0.2 room-units in the firing direction on the player's row. Rocks block the ring from hitting targets behind them. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse, radius ~2 tiles); bomb count decrements on placement. Q and Space do nothing — don't retry. Diagonal moves stall against rocks; single-axis moves also stall when a rock's hitbox extends past its sprite; reposition to another lane to free movement. Hatch/trapdoor warps need near-exact x-centering and a sustained walk started ~0.1–0.2 units from the frame; standing ON the frame blocks the warp (step off, re-center, retry; sometimes several attempts). HUD layout confirmed: coins, bombs, keys. A key-shaped sprite pickup did NOT raise keys (keys stayed 00), so earlier 'keyhole tests' with 01 were actually bombs, not keys.

BOMBS — FAILED STRATEGY (important): the earlier belief that 'bomb placed then leaving via a hatch still detonated safely and cleared a rock ring' is CONTRADICTED. On the torch-room ring chest, placing a bomb at feet and warping out still cost a heart: the fuse outlasted the warp timing, so the blast hit the player. Cost 2 hearts across two attempts; the last one killed the run (chest did open, dropping a red heart + bomb pickup, but too late). Lesson: do NOT bomb while adjacent to self; if bombing a ring, place then retreat to a far corner and wait out the blast, and never attempt at 1 heart.

TECH X: acquired from the two-poop room pedestal in an earlier run (goggles persisted then); uncertain whether the pedestal/pill respawns. Ring killed a transformed green hopper/blob at ~0.15 units but a heart was lost in the exchange — ranged tool, not a safe one. Ring destroys poop piles in ~2 hits. Ring alone did NOT open the ringed gray chest; later, contact-open after the ring rocks were cleared worked (gave a bomb pickup and a red heart). Plain tears/contact open plain gray chests. Observed a white slit mark on a fired-at chest; meaning unresolved.

PICKUPS: hearts need overlap (+1 heart). Coins need near-exact overlap; some gold specks never register; exact tolerance unresolved. Bomb pickups auto-collect on overlap.

POOP PILES: two-poop room piles destroy but fully regenerate on re-entry (drop only 1 coin total). Torch-room pile also regenerates. Grinding them is unproductive.

MAP / ROUTES (confirmed): Tutorial top trapezoid x~0.50 ↔ rock field (both ways). Tutorial bottom trapezoid x~0.49–0.50 ↔ torch room. Tutorial right doorway y~0.47 ↔ dark chest room (avoid). Torch room: top alcove x~0.50 ↔ tutorial (approach from ~0.1 below, centered); clear left lane x~0.31–0.42; center-lower rock cluster blocks direct descent — route up to y~0.33, right along top to x~0.66, down the right lane (watch bottom-right torch), then left along the bottom to the gold trapdoor x~0.50 ↔ two-poop room (enter from ~0.1 above, centered). Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50 (approach from ~0.1 below). Rock field bottom trapezoid ~x0.49 ↔ tutorial; rock field top exit → TNT room. TNT room: barrels line the left wall; gray chests wedged ~y0.30 and ~y0.63; red-lidded brown barrel near the lower one. Beyond TNT: pink-enemy rock room (pink fat enemies, poop pile with blue flies).

HAZARDS: rock field is a damaging spawner/transit room — hoppers teleport to doorways, blobs self-ring with spiky rocks, transform into a winged/spread form and a large fast-damaging green blob; white-faced blobs appear, including at bottom. Stay 2+ tiles clear, avoid center/upper-right, leave early. A spiky ring blob can form directly beside the player and cost a heart. Corner torches damage on contact. Dark chest room (black spiders/blobs, chasers) is a heart-draining dead end — avoid. A green gem-like blob/gem in the rock field (upper area) coincided with a heart loss and a green glowing blob appearing — treat as TRAP/damaging, effect still uncertain; do not approach. Death = empty grey heart outlines + bloodied/enlarged sprite with dark mass.

GOALS: hearts are the priority resource; keys were never obtained; open red-lidded chests (no key yet); test the rock-field keyhole door (~0.19,0.44) only with a confirmed key.

UNRESOLVED: what opens the golden keyhole door; whether keys exist and where; whether red-lidded containers need keys; green gem effect; whether the Tech X pill respawns; the white slit mark's meaning; whether lasers can open a chest through a rock ring (evidence: no); exact coin pickup tolerance; how long bomb fuse lasts relative to hatch-warp timing (observed: longer than a 0.5s walk-up warp).
